intro: Bunny kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces built around rabbit ears — rounded ears like ᐢ and ᕱ, or floppy ears drawn with ／ and ＼. A bunny kaomoji such as (•ㅅ•) or ／(^ ᆺ ^)＼ is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and usernames. Browse by style below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "bunny kaomoji" or "kaomoji bunny," every rabbit here is free to copy and paste.
